package.description: Instant audio playback device switching for Windows.

en-US.description: Instant audio playback device switching for Windows.
en-US.longDescription:
AudioSwitcher is a fast, lightweight Windows desktop application designed to eliminate the hassle of switching between audio playback devices (e.g. TV, desktop speakers, and headphones).
Features include one-click switching, customizable device rotation, friendly custom nicknames for cryptic hardware IDs, global keyboard shortcut (Ctrl + Alt + A) that works in full-screen applications, and system tray integration with live device tracking.
en-US.name: AudioSwitcher
